items.title: Sony brings PS5 Pro-style AI upscaling to regular PS5 with new QSSR tech
items.excerpt: Sony is bringing AI-powered upscaling to the standard PS5 with Quick Spectral Super Resolution, or QSSR, a lighter counterpart to the PSSR technology used on PS5 Pro. Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei are the first games to support it, with Sony planning to make the technology broadly available to PlayStation developers.

items.title: Xiaomi launches new heat pump washer-dryer with AI wash suggestions
items.excerpt: Xiaomi has launched its first heat pump washer-dryer in China, a 13kg-wash, 9kg-dry Mijia model with a recommended price of CNY 6,499 (about $970). Xiaomi claims the heat pump uses 73% less electricity than a condenser washer-dryer and dries 49% faster with twin fans, while a large language model recommends programmes from users' descriptions of their clothes.

items.title: Apple's cheapest iPad is finally getting Apple Intelligence, leaked code shows
items.excerpt: Leaked code reveals that the upcoming iPad 12 will feature notable hardware upgrades designed specifically to support Apple Intelligence. The entry-level tablet is expected to include the A19 chip and 8GB of RAM to meet the strict memory requirements for advanced Siri capabilities.
